criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name a specific date (June 1), carrier (GCI), six communities, and pivot to the capital-pitch tension. Stands alone at the see-more cutoff with a concrete stake. No banned opener.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every paragraph anchors to Alaska and names a consequence: DAF 4,700-acre lease, $500M North Slope proposal, $4.6B USF regime under FCC review, GCI-Quintillion $310M, $121.2M BEAD, Chugach gas constraint.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named entities, dates, dollar figures, and agencies in virtually every sentence. Density sustained, not front-loaded.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: GCI break: two independent in-window sources (Alaska Public Media + KUCB). USF: ADN + ProPublica. DAF: Air and Space Forces Magazine + ADN. Quintillion/BEAD: GCI newsroom (primary). Minor dock: Stak $500M is single-sourced (partial), but properly hedged as preliminary approval.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Structurally analytical and position-taking, matching post_001.md. Minor dock for one slightly casual line.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 409 words, 2505 chars. Paragraphs 2-4 sentences. Clean mobile scan. Meets every descriptor-10 condition.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Genuinely debatable, specific question tied to the structural tension. No softener, no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Allocator/PM can name concrete revisit triggers: the just-closed DAF lease and the FCC Alaska Plan review as subsidy-regime risk. Minor dock for implicit action frame.

one_sentence_fix: Strengthen the Stak $500M North Slope claim with a second independent source or explicit attribution to Alaska Public Media so the single-source status is transparent.
